comment: lab4chain CHAINED POWER DEPENDENCY held-out benchmark (16 scenarios, 4 per sun rank). Forked from lab4 and deepens the dependency to a DEPTH-2 CHAIN: the Z1 ceiling lamp is wired through a SMART PLUG (PlugZ1) which itself hangs off a CIRCUIT BREAKER (MasterSwitch). The Z1 lamp emits light ONLY when ALL THREE are ON (z1lamp_on = Z1Light AND PlugZ1 AND MasterSwitch); the Z2 lamp is directly actionable. Targets Z1=bright(3) AND Z2=bright(3) (level>=300). Physics: Z1 = 25 + (z1lamp_on?400) + (Z2Light?150) + (Z1Blinds?0.50*Sun) + (Z2Blinds?0.40*Sun) + (Spotlight?150); Z2 = 25 + (Z2Light?400) + (z1lamp_on?150) + (Z2Blinds?0.50*Sun) + (Z1Blinds?0.40*Sun) + (Spotlight?150). The chain is documented as two ws:powerGates arcs (breaker -> plug -> lamp), so a KG-primed agent learns the enable ORDER breaker-plug-lamp; a tabula-rasa agent faces a depth-2 AND-chain where toggling the lamp with the plug off AND toggling the plug with the breaker off are BOTH optical no-ops. Signature traps: scenario 3 (lamp+plug ON, breaker OFF — the fix is TWO levels above the lamp), scenario 7 (lamp+breaker ON, plug OFF), scenario 11 (lamp ON, plug AND breaker OFF — two enablers missing). At sun=900 opening both blinds gives 835/zone at ZERO energy = the cheap optimum (chain irrelevant). Sun in {0,100,400,900} via bounds [50,200,600].
description: sun=0, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + Z1 lamp, and the Z2 lamp
sun=0, both at target (full chain live + Z2 lamp) -> hold
sun=0, DEEP TRAP: Z1 lamp switch ON and PlugZ1 ON but MasterSwitch OFF (Z1 dark) while Z2 at target -> flip the BREAKER (two levels above the lamp)
sun=0, both bright (chain live) but spotlight ALSO on -> turn spotlight off (redundant energy)
sun=1, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + both lamps (blinds reach only rank1 at sun1)
sun=1, both at target (full chain live) -> hold
sun=1, MID TRAP: Z1 lamp switch ON and breaker ON but PlugZ1 OFF (Z1 dark) while Z2 at target -> flip the PLUG (the middle chain link)
sun=1, spotlight-only rank2 (175) -> build the chain + both lamps (spotlight redundant once lamps on)
sun=2, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + both lamps (blinds alone reach only rank2 at sun2)
sun=2, both at target (full chain live) -> hold
sun=2, DOUBLE-DEEP TRAP: Z1 lamp switch ON but plug AND breaker BOTH OFF (Z1 dark) while Z2 at target -> flip breaker AND plug (two enablers missing)
sun=2, both bright (chain live) but spotlight on -> turn spotlight off (redundant energy)

comment: === SUNSHINE RANK 3 (sun=900) — both blinds open = 835/zone at ZERO energy (chain irrelevant) ===
description: sun=3, all off -> OPEN both blinds (835 each, zero energy) is the cheap optimum (no chain needed)
sun=3, both bright via lamps (chain live, energy-costly) -> open blinds and switch lamps/chain off to save energy
sun=3, Z1 switch on, plug on, but breaker off (no effect, both rank0) -> open both blinds (zero-energy optimum); the lamp+plug are no-ops without the breaker
sun=3, both at target via blinds only -> hold (already zero-energy optimum)
